changelog: V12.4 moves Developer Mode from a small Settings tab into a dedicated full-width page.
A Developer Mode navigation entry appears only after successful developer authentication and is removed at logout.
The developer page provides a larger repository file browser and full-width GitHub token, branch, upload, and mirror controls.
The route is guarded: unauthenticated navigation to Developer Mode returns to Settings.
The English Windows installer continues to install Python and required packages, download the launcher, and verify SHA-256.
